detail: design polished; 2 decisions + 1 cosmetic wart flagged
text:
a design pass would break this codebase: Calendar gets per-type colour via a neutral `data-type` hook styled from each module's own CSS — no type name enters `Calendar.tsx`, because `genericity.test.ts` greps the source. And Notes keeps its no-edit-mode decision; the fix is `field-sizing: content` so an empty note collapses to one line while staying a real always-editable field.

Your 4,000-line uncommitted redesign is backed up to `scratchpad/pre-polish.patch` before any agent touched a file. I'll report when it lands.

Workflow finished — 12 agents, 0 errors. Let me read the full result and verify the tree myself.

All green: `tsc` exit 0, 382/382 tests, 2 pre-existing biome warnings in a file nobody touched. Now the part that actually matters — looking at it.

Notes went from overflowing the pane to three scannable rows; todos quieted to one handle at rest; the select is dressed. Let me verify the two hardest fixes — Inspector at 1×1, and Calendar.

Done. Dev server stopped, browser tab closed.

## What changed

Nothing is committed — it's all in your working tree, on top of the redesign that was already there. Your pre-existing 4,000-line diff is backed up at `scratchpad/pre-polish.patch` if you need to separate the two.

**New shared layer** — `src/ui/ui.css` had exactly one primitive (`.icon-btn`); every other control drew its own box in its own module file. It now carries `.field`, `.select` (+`.select-shell`/`.select-chevron`), `.chip` (+`is-accent`/`is-quiet`) and `.stat`. `.field`'s geometry was copied verbatim from `.todo-input` so the best-looking existing field became the standard rather than a new one competing with it.

**The five fixes, verified in the running app:**

| | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Notes | 3 notes overflowed the pane — every row a permanent `rows={3}` textarea | `field-sizing: content` + `rows={1}`: empty note = one line, caps at `8lh`. No edit mode introduced |
| Journal | composer *and* a "Write today's entry" command doing the same job; body in monospace | one composer; body is sans at `--measure-prose` with a quiet dateline |
| Inspector | opened inline and its "Add link" button was **sliced off** by the pane edge | contained, scrolls internally, submit reachable at 1×1 (~360×340) |
| Habits | raw unstyled `<select>`, naked `0` | dressed select with themed chevron; ticking a habit now reads "**1** day streak" |
| Calendar | entries were an invisible hairline | tinted chips with real weight |
| Todos | three icons per row at rest | one handle at rest, full set on hover and on touch |

## Two things worth your attention

**A decision I couldn't make for you.** The repair agent found `theme.ts` + `index.html` keep a `localStorage` paint cache to avoid a white flash on dark boot. The *state* goes through the `pref` op and the log overrules the cache on every boot, so invariant 1's stated reason isn't breached — but the invariant says "never into `localStorage`" flatly. Either amend invariant 1 to record the exception, or say the word and I'll rip the pre-paint script out (costs a white flash on the phone, and `tokens.test.ts` pins the resolver set, so that test changes too).

**One wart I can see and the agents didn't flag.** On a note row the link handle sits on its own line below the calendar/trash pair instead of aligned with them — the note is a two-row block and the generic `.item-row` centres the handle against the whole block. Cosmetic, but it's the one place the four panes still don't line up.

Also: the calendar's per-type colouring is wired but unpainted. `Calendar.tsx` emits `data-type` (no type name enters the file — `genericity.test.ts` still passes), so each module needs to write `.calendar-entry[data-type="todo"] { … }` in its own CSS to claim a hue. Right now they all share the neutral default.

`bun run check` exits 0, `tsc` clean, 382/382 tests pass. The two biome warnings are pre-existing `noCommaOperator` hits in `src/core/migrations.test.ts`, untouched by any of this.

detail: 8,356-line commit ready; awaiting git push origin main
text:
Before merging: nothing here is committed yet, and the one suite nobody ran is Playwright — which is exactly the suite that depends on the `data-testid`s this pass moved. Let me check state and run it.

E2E green — 56 passed, 4 skipped (viewport-conditional). Let me check the repo's commit-message convention before writing one.

E2E is green and `main` is a clean fast-forward (2 commits behind, 0 ahead). Committing on `grid-panes` first.

Merged. `main` is at `b5f8aa9`, a clean fast-forward — no merge commit, no conflicts.

```
b5f8aa9  one vocabulary, and every pane speaks it        ← new
0ad077d  pages are panes in a grid you arrange…
9913eb5  state that is about the app, not about an entity, is still an op
05c9c11  say so when a command throws
```

Verified on `main` after the merge: `check` clean (`tsc` exit 0; the 2 biome warnings are the pre-existing `noCommaOperator` pair in `src/core/migrations.test.ts`), 382 unit tests, and **56 Playwright tests** across desktop and mobile viewports — I ran the e2e suite before committing, since it was the one thing nobody had run and it's the suite that depends on the `data-testid`s this pass moved. 4 skips are the viewport-conditional ones.

**Not pushed.** `main` is ahead of `origin/main` by 3. When you want it:

```sh
git push origin main
```

## One thing you should know about the commit

It's a single commit of 8,356 insertions, and CLAUDE.md says small commits, one concern each. I couldn't honestly split it. The working tree held two overlapping bodies of work — your in-flight redesign and this session's polish pass — and they touch the same files. I snapshotted the *tracked* diff before starting (`pre-polish.patch`), but the untracked files this pass also modified (`src/ui/ui.css`, `src/ui/icons.tsx`, `src/styles/tokens.test.ts`) have no pre-session snapshot, so there's no line-accurate way to reconstruct "before". Faking a split would have produced two commits neither of which was true. If you'd rather it were split, the honest path is `git reset --soft HEAD~1` and staging by hand.

The commit body documents the *why* for each change in the repo's voice, including the rejected alternatives — the data-URI chevron, the no-edit-mode constraint on notes, the `field-sizing` Chromium trade-off.

## Still open from the review

- **The `localStorage` paint cache** in `theme.ts` + `index.html` — just merged to `main` as-is. State goes through the `pref` op and the log overrules the cache each boot, but invariant 1 reads as an absolute. Amend the invariant to record the exception, or tell me and I'll remove the pre-paint script (costs a white flash on dark boot, and `tokens.test.ts` pins the resolver set so that test changes too).
- **Calendar per-type colour is wired but unpainted** — `data-type` is emitted; no module claims a hue yet, so they all share the neutral default.
- **The note-row alignment wart** — the link handle sits below the calendar/trash pair rather than level with them, because the note is a two-row block and the generic `.item-row` centres against the whole block.
